scope: one tiny synthetic B0 engineering pilot, no hyperparameter search or research-quality claim

training.optimizer: AdamW existing defaults; serialize all resolved settings
training.IMU_normalization: 01 recompute at exact admitted 20Hz input times, unique train clips only, bind to checkpoint
training.motion_normalization: retain pretrained MDM Mean/Std and bind hashes; do not refit on 3 clips
training.checkpoint_selection: final update 200 only; no validation early-selection

sampling.noise: existing addressed noise, same original length and random_plan_case_id across six conditions
sampling.static: zero raw acceleration plus first observed sensor orientation held constant; use admitted training normalization
sampling.numeric_zero: all-zero NORMALIZED tensor with sensor presence retained
sampling.imu_only: text presence false, not merely a nonempty text replacement
sampling.bypass: raw frozen MDM path with identical text CFG/noise; strict-null comparison saved
sampling.shuffled: not_estimable: no same-action, near-length donor in the admitted fixed panel; no cross-action substitute
sampling.outputs: full feature tensors, decoded joints, input tensors, masks/timestamps, all noise hashes, config and checkpoint/data hashes, runtime/memory

resource_caps.device: 01 must name one available existing GPU and verify driver/free memory immediately before run; current 02 nvidia-smi cannot reach driver
resource_caps.stop: first cap reached, NaN/Inf, identity mismatch or OOM; retain partial/failure records, no unbudgeted retry or CPU fallback

execution_dependencies: owner-01 explicit canonical_smpl_paired_v1 adapter and provenance binding
owner-02 verify admitted input replay after that concrete adapter exists
